maria_cs: FYI: visibility gap during onboarding metrics window 02:15-02:35 UTC affected ~24 tenants (many pilot/renewal). drafting customer note. :slightly_frowning_face:
sam_ops_bot: [ALERT] ingest-eu-west reported transient 503s at 02:18; autoscale restarted replica group.
oliver_se: Is this impacting embeddings or provisioned dedicated pools? Any user-facing failures?
jasdeep_eng: Root cause: config rollout changed consumer group offsets -> small subset of messages processed without tenant tag. Gen endpoints unaffected. We ran a backfill but two tenants need manual re-ingest.
diane_pm: Proposed short note: "We had a short metrics ingestion issue on <DATE> which may have delayed onboarding progress indicators. We have backfilled most data and are scheduling manual re-ingest for two accounts. No user data or model outputs were exposed. We're offering a 1-month account credit and a dedicated 7-day onboarding concierge to impacted customers. Full RCA and office hours within 48h."
kevin_se: Add expected customer symptoms: missing progress counts, delayed example indexing. Include booking link and support contact.
maria_cs: I'll send tailored DMs to high-touch renewals at 08:45 UTC, then automated email at 09:30 UTC. Please approve copy.
jasdeep_eng: Approved. Rollback executed at 02:24; backfill finished for 22/24. Manual re-ingest ETA 4-6 hours. Adding preflight to rollout pipeline to detect offset shifts.
oliver_se: I'll create alert for consumer-group-offset-drift and attach runbook.
maria_cs: Sent to high-touch. Will capture feedback during office hours and escalate extra credit requests case-by-case. Closing thread once RCA posted. :white_check_mark:
